mandatory_checks.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder

fail.subcontractor: required bidder-held licence not demonstrated (licensed electrical work is assigned to a subcontractor)
fail.none: proposal states the bidder holds no required licence

mandatory_checks.label: WSIB clearance
mandatory_checks.fail: proposal states the bidder has no WSIB clearance

project_limits.label: Complete within 16 weeks of award
project_limits.missing: completion time not stated, so the 16-week limit cannot be checked

security_flag_message: an instruction aimed at automated reviewers was detected and ignored; it is recorded in the audit log for a reviewer to acknowledge

criteria.label: Relevant experience
criteria.description: min(100, qualifying installs in the window / 12 x 100)

criteria.label: Price
criteria.detail: CAD {price_total_cad:,}; best eligible ranked bid CAD {best:,}
criteria.description: lowest price among ranked bids / this price x 100

criteria.label: Timeline
criteria.detail: {completion_weeks} weeks; fastest eligible ranked bid {best} weeks
criteria.description: fewest weeks among ranked bids / this bid's weeks x 100

criteria.label: Warranty
criteria.description: average of min(100, panel years / 25 x 100) and min(100, workmanship years / 12 x 100)

criteria.label: Team and approach
criteria.description: 25 points for each item the proposal states; items not stated earn 0 and are listed

extraction_fields.name: bidder_name
extraction_fields.definition: string. The company submitting the proposal.

extraction_fields.name: licence_holder
extraction_fields.definition: exactly one of "bidder", "subcontractor", "none", "not_stated". "bidder": the bidder itself states it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence. "subcontractor": the proposal says the licensed electrical work will be done by another party, and does not say the bidder itself holds the licence. "none": the proposal explicitly says the bidder holds no such licence. "not_stated": the proposal says nothing about who holds the licence. The value is always one of these four words. Use status "confirmed" for the first three, "not_stated" for "not_stated", and "ambiguous" (with value "not_stated") when the wording is too unclear to choose.

extraction_fields.name: licence_number
extraction_fields.definition: string. The bidder's own licence number, copied exactly as written; null if only another party's licence is mentioned.

extraction_fields.name: wsib_clearance
extraction_fields.definition: true / false / null (rule 8). The bidder's own WSIB clearance.

extraction_fields.name: liability_insurance_cad
extraction_fields.definition: number. The liability coverage the bidder itself states it carries, as a plain number in CAD (for example 5000000). Null if not stated or attributed to another party. Use 0 only if the proposal explicitly says the bidder carries none.

extraction_fields.name: experience_count
extraction_fields.definition: number. How many commercial installations of 100 kW or more the bidder says it completed.

extraction_fields.name: experience_period_text
extraction_fields.definition: string. The words the proposal uses for the time period of that experience (for example "since 2021" or "in the last three years"), copied exactly.

extraction_fields.name: price_total_cad
extraction_fields.definition: number. The total price in CAD as a plain number.

extraction_fields.name: price_scope_text
extraction_fields.definition: string. What the proposal says the price includes or excludes (permits, utility connection, taxes), copied exactly; null if it says nothing.

extraction_fields.name: completion_weeks
extraction_fields.definition: number. Time to complete after award, in weeks. Null if the schedule is not given as a definite length.

extraction_fields.name: panel_warranty_years
extraction_fields.definition: number. Panel warranty length in years.

extraction_fields.name: workmanship_warranty_years
extraction_fields.definition: number. Workmanship warranty length in years.

extraction_fields.name: named_project_lead
extraction_fields.definition: true / false / null (rule 8). True if the proposal says a named or specific project lead or project manager will lead the work, even if the person's name is not given; "to be assigned later" is null with status "ambiguous".

extraction_fields.name: crew_size
extraction_fields.definition: number. Number of crew members stated; null if not stated.

extraction_fields.name: safety_plan
extraction_fields.definition: true / false / null (rule 8). A site or project safety plan.

extraction_fields.name: monitoring_plan
extraction_fields.definition: true / false / null (rule 8). Ongoing performance monitoring of the installed system. Progress reports during construction do not count.
